title: Zelensky Calls Witkoff and Kushner to Lock In Dates for Long-Delayed First Kyiv Visit
detail: August 31, 2026 — President Volodymyr Zelensky held a phone call with Trump envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to nail down dates for their first-ever visit to Kyiv, which the two men — despite having made multiple trips to Moscow to meet Putin — have yet to undertake. Zelensky called the conversation 'detailed and constructive,' said a visit 'would be highly beneficial for hammering out solutions for peace,' and confirmed the discussion also covered battlefield conditions. He separately warned that intelligence assessments show Putin remains committed to continuing the war. The call follows reports that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met Russian Finance Minister Anton Siluanov to discuss Trump's peace plan — a meeting Kyiv said it had no prior knowledge of.

title: African Union Welcomes New 'Sudanese-Sudanese Dialogue' Initiative Amid Civil Society Pushback
detail: August 31, 2026 — The African Union Commission issued a press statement welcoming a proposed 'Sudanese-Sudanese dialogue,' to be held inside Sudan under the supervision of an independent committee of Sudanese elders, and covering civil society, political groups, and broader Sudanese stakeholders. The Commission said the initiative 'reinforces the African Union's roadmap and the Quintet Mechanism track' and emphasized 'genuine Sudanese ownership and leadership' of the process, with objectives including establishing civilian-led governance and a unified national security architecture. The statement follows Burhan's Aug. 15 pledge of temporary immunity for dialogue participants and the AU Peace and Security Council delegation's Aug. 15-16 Khartoum visit, but several civilian and political groups — including the anti-war coalition that rejected Burhan's dialogue offer in Addis Ababa on Aug. 22-23 — have warned that talks absent a ceasefire risk entrenching the warring parties rather than building peace.
